opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (£750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students, and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of viva (not undergraduates/Master's). Must present a poster or give a talk.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of junior scientist members at genetics conferences. Three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: Quarterly at midnight on 15th February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short training courses or make a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: Quarterly at midnight on 1st February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects whose results would typically be suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of age of the person they care for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings, providing an award to be used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several hundred pounds for a specific lecture up to about £1,000 for a session; major sponsorship typically £1,000-£2,000, potentially several thousand pounds

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, used towards the organisation of a one-off meeting.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: Two deadlines per year (1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
